title: Cozy Fireplace Vibes | Town & Country Direct Vent Gas Fireplace TC42
description: The TC42 gas fireplace is Town & Country’s flagship hearth, the first to introduce the clean-face category, revolutionizing the industry. With dynamic, full flames, it commands presence in any room and can be customized to your tastes – from traditional to contemporary, the choice is yours. Shown here with black porcelain reflective panels & the country home burner/logs. Great work from our team on this install 💪🏼
